neighbours.label: The pronoun 'we' / 'We' starting a clause after 'but', 'so' or a sentence end in opinion writing ('but we should also recognize', 'so we can learn', 'We celebrate festivities')
fire: More research is often suggested, but we should also recognize that a point comes when talking stops.

Life here is decidedly uncool to most people. We celebrate the festivals, and we love the costumes.
The data are thin, but we can say that prices rose in every district last year.
There is no easy answer, so we have to be honest about what we do not know.
He asked for patience. We gave him a year, and we got excuses in return.
